verdict.rationale: Terraform has no native natural-language interface of its own. Its official MCP server lets external AI assistants operate it: it supplies registry docs, modules and policies for configuration generation, and offers workspace create/update/delete and run management. Natural-language operation is therefore possible, but only through a third-party AI client, and run management is limited to HCP Terraform workspaces. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface in the CLI or product, documented end-to-end natural-language plan/apply flows, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably.
